findings.title: A carry label does not prove active borrowing
findings.text: TAU had funded wstETH collateral but less than one dollar of tracked USDC debt at T. Its approved nested route belongs in the mechanism map; its full book should not be labelled an active dollar carry allocation.

findings.title: Nested savings carry has two independent financing tests
findings.text: Reservoir combines an Aave WETH/USDC loan with a Morpho wsrUSD/USDC loan. The outer loan has a different rate, collateral buffer and exit dependency from the inner loan. A single leverage multiple hides that difference.

findings.title: A savings accrual schedule is not proof of underlying profit
findings.text: At T, wsrUSD reports a configured annual growth factor close to 1.06. This is about 6% after subtracting the initial principal. It is not a verified cash-profit attribution or a guaranteed stablecoin exit value.

findings.title: A published ETH mark can be stale even when supply is current
findings.text: The Midas token supplies can be read at T, but their issuer NAV oracle timestamps predate T. Show mark age beside capital, and keep both products outside confirmed E4 until actual ETH collateral and dollar debt are established.

findings.title: A material book allocation is not proof of product-specific financing
findings.text: Concrete wstETH Plus routes essentially its full book through one MultisigStrategy. The shared execution Safe and its debt still cannot establish how much dollar funding or arbitrage income belongs to this product.

findings.title: Protocol names do not identify the investment instrument
findings.text: The Rocksolid report discloses a $2m Spectra allocation. Without the actual instrument, maturity and T position, it should not become a fixed-rate PT return claim.

economics_boundary.formula: Incremental annual equity return = sum(destination capital / equity × destination yield) - sum(debt / equity × borrowing cost) - fees and execution costs. Add only separately evidenced ETH collateral income.
economics_boundary.assumptions: Frozen rates, constant ETH/USD and stablecoin parity for a scenario. No backward application of T weights.
